discard_edits: Discard the unsaved changes for this brand?
choose_knowledge_brand: Choose the brand whose answers and documents you want to manage.
website_depth: Reads up to 24 public pages, following product links and the website’s sitemap.
visitor_facts: Company facts for the public chatbot
visitor_hint: Select the facts visitors may receive in a chat. Saving the profile makes future changes to these values available to the chatbot.
goal_hint: Shared with this brand’s chatbot. What should a successful customer conversation achieve?
email_instructions_hint: Used for proposals and email replies. For example, lead with the answer and ask one question if artwork is missing. Your email app adds the signature.
name_prompt: Company name and location if needed
upload_hint: Choose files or drop them here.
upload_limits: Up to {{count}} files. {{formats}}. {{each}} MB each and {{total}} MB total.

intro.sources: Use existing chatbot knowledge, a website, public search or files to fill this brand’s profile. You can also enter details manually.
intro.company: Describe the business and what it stands for.
intro.market: Describe who you serve, where you work, and what makes your offer different.
intro.services: Record what you sell and the details the AI should use in proposals.
intro.review: Check the profile and save the details you want the CRM to use.

errors.capture_sources_required: Choose chatbot knowledge, add a website or file, or enter a company to search for.
errors.capture_website_unreadable: This website could not be read. Check the address or use another source.
errors.capture_website_indexed: The website suggestions come from a public search of its pages.
errors.capture_web_unverified: The web search found too little information to verify this business. Add its official website to help match it.
errors.capture_web_unavailable: Public web search was unavailable during this capture.
errors.capture_documents_unreadable: The AI could not read the chosen documents. Try a readable PDF or another supported file.
errors.capture_no_findings: The sources did not yield any profile suggestions.
errors.capture_timed_out: Capture took too long. Try again with fewer sources.
errors.capture_access_changed: Access to this business profile changed during capture.
errors.file_size: The file is empty or exceeds the limit for one file.
errors.file_total: The combined files exceed the upload limit.
errors.file_rejected: Check the file types and sizes, then try the upload again.
